title: An Octopus Has Three Hearts
script: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Two hearts push blood through its gills. The third sends it to the rest of the body. Its blood uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen, and that makes it blue. Here's the strange part. When an octopus swims, its main heart stops beating. That's why it would rather crawl than swim. So an animal with three hearts gets tired easily.
